title: Analytics Aggregation Across Workspaces
description:
Create Analytics Aggregation Service for Workspace Invitation Metrics

Build a backend service that aggregates invitation-related analytics across a workspace, enabling workspace owners to view combined metrics and insights for all invitations they've sent.

Requirements:

**Core Aggregation Features:**
- Aggregate metrics across all invitations within a workspace (total sent, pending, accepted, declined, expired)
- Calculate acceptance rates, average time-to-accept, and invitation conversion funnels
- Support time-based filtering (daily, weekly, monthly, custom date ranges)
- Group metrics by relevant dimensions (invitee role, invitation method, time period)

**API Design:**
- Create RESTful endpoints for retrieving aggregated analytics
- Support query parameters for filtering and grouping options
- Implement pagination for detailed breakdowns with many records
- Return data in a format suitable for dashboard visualization (charts, tables)

**Access Control:**
- Restrict analytics access to workspace owners and authorized admins only
- Validate workspace membership before returning any data
- Audit log access to analytics data

**Performance Considerations:**
- Implement caching strategy for frequently requested aggregations
- Consider pre-computing common aggregations on a schedule
- Optimize queries to handle workspaces with large invitation volumes
- Add database indexes to support aggregation queries efficiently

**Data Points to Track:**
- Invitation status distribution (pending/accepted/declined/expired)
- Invitation volume over time (trend analysis)
- Response time metrics (how quickly invitations are acted upon)
- Breakdown by invitation type or role if applicable

**Edge Cases to Handle:**
- Workspaces with zero invitations (return empty state, not errors)
- Very large workspaces with thousands of invitations
- Date ranges with no activity
- Recently deleted or revoked invitations
